mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_coupon_template_create_request (shop_number, request_id, request_hash, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{shopNumber}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE update_time = update_time
mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_number, request_id, request_hash, template_id, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_coupon_template_create_request WHERE shop_number = #{shopNumber} AND request_id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_coupon_template_create_request SET template_id = #{templateId}, status = 'SUCCESS', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_number = #{shopNumber} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
